decision.summary: Three candidate temporary offsets identified in allowed context [475,699]: (1) confirmed U-dip 520–524 with clear onset and sustained interior; (2) uncertain second U-dip 550–552 with ambiguous return; (3) uncertain N-shift 510–543 overlapping first U event, with incomplete return. No full opposing return observed for any interval; co-occurring transients in N/E support multi-axis nature but do not confirm closure.

intervals.observation: U drops sharply from ~0 to ~-2 over 3–4 samples (520–523), with N and E showing concurrent negative transients; interior sustained at offset level through 524, no return observed before 525.

U exhibits second abrupt dip near 550 (~-1.8), preceded by partial rebound; N/E show correlated minor dips; interior offset persists through 552, but recovery begins immediately after—return not fully completed within allowed context.
N shows sustained negative shift from ~510 to ~543 (≈−1 MAD), coincident with first U dip; E shows weaker transient; return begins at 544 but is incomplete/overlapped by next event.
